compression: ATR14/close on signal bar must be <= 20th percentile of the previous 90 completed 4h bars, current bar excluded from percentile
breakout: LONG close > highest high of previous 20 completed bars; SHORT close < lowest low of previous 20 completed bars
directions: LONG and SHORT symmetric; otherwise NO_TRADE
positioning: one position per symbol; no overlap on same symbol; equal-risk conceptual sleeves; historical report uses per-trade R and equal-weight portfolio diagnostics
funding: actual funding during open position included; positive benefit haircut 20% and negative funding cost magnified 20% under stress/severe
promotion_note: historical pass grants research/shadow eligibility only; no order authority
